description: In the heart of Vienna, a series of art thefts have left the city in turmoil. The stolen pieces are rumored to hold secrets of a hidden treasure. As you delve into the world of art collectors and thieves, you must navigate through a web of deceit and misdirection to uncover the true culprit behind the heists. Each suspect presents a façade, but only one holds the key to the mystery.

reasoning_chain: Lukas Novak is the only suspect with a hobby directly linked to the thefts.
His vehicle matches the description given by witnesses.
His background as a wealthy collector aligns with the motive for theft.
Other suspects have hobbies that do not directly connect to the art thefts.

solution: Connect the clues about Lukas Novak's obsession with rare art and his nervous behavior when leaving the castle.
